description: MPEG-1 Layer II at 48000 Hz and 112 kbps carrying 3/2 with an extension bitstream and 12 bytes of MPEG-1 ancillary data, whose fourth frame's multichannel header declares 255 bytes: more than the frame holds after the header and its CRC. That frame's multichannel data is taken to end after the CRC, and the bytes after it are ancillary data.

findings.contains: 1 frame declares more MPEG-1 ancillary bytes
